example.en: Please contact technical support if anyone else in your department experiences network issues.
example.zh: 若您部門內有其他任何人遇到網路問題，請與技術支援聯絡。

words.mnemonic: 代名詞搭配：anyone else (任何人)、anything else (其他任何事)。

example.en: The client inquired about the shipping availability of that particular model of laser printer.
example.zh: 客戶洽詢了那一款特定型號雷射印表機的出貨供應情況。

words.mnemonic: 片語大考點：in particular (特別是/尤其)。

example.en: Effective communication plays a vital role in successful cross-functional project management.
example.zh: 有效的溝通在成功的跨部門專案管理中扮演著至關重要的角色。

words.mnemonic: 多益職場閱讀極高頻片語：play an important role in (扮演要角)。

example.en: We are thrilled to announce that Mr. Davis will join our executive leadership team next Monday.
example.zh: 我們非常榮幸地宣布，戴維斯先生將於下週一加入我們的高階主管團隊。

words.mnemonic: 新進員工公告必備動詞：join the company / join the team。

example.en: Navigating currency exchange fluctuations made international financial planning difficult.
example.zh: 因應匯率波動使得國際財務規劃變得相當棘手困難。

words.mnemonic: 問題描述形容詞：difficult situation (困難局面)、difficult task (艱鉅任務)。

example.en: Please remember to sign the visitor log before proceeding to the executive conference room.
example.zh: 在前往高階主管會議室之前，請務必記得在訪客登記簿上簽名。

words.mnemonic: 多益公文指示最標準句首：Please note that... (請注意...)。

example.en: The project coordinator will explain the specific implementation details during tomorrow's session.
example.zh: 專案協調員將在明天的會議中詳細說明具體的實施細節。

words.mnemonic: 多益必背片語：in detail (詳細地)、contact details (聯絡資訊)。

example.en: The sales representative explained the key functional differences between the two smartphone models.
example.zh: 業務代表解釋了這兩款智慧型手機機型之間的主要功能差異。

words.mnemonic: 片語大考點：make a difference (產生重大影響)、difference between (兩者之差)。

example.en: Management must take prompt corrective action to address the supply chain disruption.
example.zh: 管理層必須立即採取矯正行動以解決供應鏈中斷問題。

words.mnemonic: 高頻職場搭配：take action (採取行動)、action plan (行動方案)。

example.en: The corporate employee wellness program includes comprehensive dental and health insurance coverage.
example.zh: 企業員工健康福利計畫涵蓋了全面的牙科與健康醫療保險保障。

words.mnemonic: 員工福利核心詞：health insurance (健保)、health and safety (工安衛生)。

example.en: Seminar participants may eat lunch in the hotel dining hall or visit nearby local restaurants.
example.zh: 研討會與會者可在飯店宴會餐廳享用午餐，亦可造訪附近的在地餐館。

words.mnemonic: 生活與差旅餐飲動詞；片語 eat out (外出用餐)。

example.en: The human resources department outlined three simple steps for submitting online vacation requests.
example.zh: 人力資源部列出了線上提交休假申請的三個簡易步驟。

words.mnemonic: 標準作業流程 (SOP) 關鍵詞：step-by-step (逐步地)、take steps (採取措施)。

example.en: The independent auditing firm confirmed that the financial statements represent a true reflection of assets.
example.zh: 獨立審計事務所確認該財務報表如實反映了資產真實狀況。

words.mnemonic: 如實反映常用詞：come true (成真/實現)、true copy (與正本相符的副本)。

example.en: Please feel free to reach our customer care hotline by phone during regular business hours.
example.zh: 歡迎在一般營業時間內透過電話撥打我們的客戶關懷專線。

words.mnemonic: 通訊工具：phone call (通話)、by phone (透過電話)。

example.en: Department managers must familiarize themselves with the updated workplace safety regulations.
example.zh: 部門主管必須親自熟悉最新修訂的職場安全法規。

words.mnemonic: 反身代名詞片語：by themselves (獨自)、familiarize themselves with (使自己熟悉)。

example.en: The international technology trade fair is expected to draw over ten thousand business delegates.
example.zh: 這場國際科技博覽會預計將吸引上萬名商務代表參與。

words.mnemonic: 多益常考「吸引注意/人潮」：draw attention to (吸引注意)、draw a conclusion (得出結論)。

example.en: The recruitment agency specializes in placing qualified white-collar administrative professionals.
example.zh: 這家人力顧問公司專門為合資格的白領行政專業人員媒合職缺。

words.mnemonic: 職場職場族群：white-collar worker (白領族/上班族)。

example.en: Passengers who need to modify their departure date may do so online without penalty fees.
example.zh: 需要修改出發日期的旅客可於線上辦理，無需繳納罰金。

words.mnemonic: 多益極高頻時效片語：up to date (最新的)、out of date (過時的)、due date (到期日)。

example.en: Adopting sustainable environmental practices helps our factory decrease energy consumption.
example.zh: 採取永續環境常規做法有助於我們的工廠降低能源消耗。

words.mnemonic: 多益商業常考「常規/最佳實踐」：best practices (最佳實務)。

example.en: The newly released laser printer model prints twenty percent faster than previous versions.
example.zh: 新發布的雷射印表機型號列印速度比先前的版本快了百分之二十。

words.mnemonic: 產品與商業模式：business model (商業模式)、latest model (最新型號)。

example.en: The startup company launched an equity offering to raise capital for overseas factory expansion.
example.zh: 這家新創公司發行股權以籌措海外擴廠所需的資本資金。

words.mnemonic: 及物動詞 (raise something)；搭配 raise funds (募資)、raise prices (提高售價)。

example.en: Delivering exceptional customer service is the cornerstone of our corporate retail philosophy.
example.zh: 提供卓越的客戶服務是我們企業零售經營哲學的基石。

words.mnemonic: 多益最核心單字：customer service (客服)、customer satisfaction (客戶滿意度)。
roots: -er 做…的人 → 慣常來買的人

example.en: Hotel guests may collect their complimentary airport shuttle passes directly at the front desk.
example.zh: 飯店房客可直接在接待櫃檯領取免費機場接駁車乘車證。

words.mnemonic: 接待必備片語：front desk (櫃檯/接待處)、in front of (在...前面)。

example.en: The project supervisor will explain the upgraded software installation procedure step by step.
example.zh: 專案主管將逐步說明升級後的軟體安裝程序。

words.mnemonic: 溝通動詞：explain something to someone (向某人解釋某事)。
roots: plain 平坦 → 攤平說明

example.en: Emergency exit doors must remain completely unobstructed by boxes or pallets at all times.
example.zh: 緊急逃生安全門在任何時候皆絕不得被紙箱或棧板阻擋妨礙。

words.mnemonic: 工安設施標誌：emergency exit door (緊急出口門)、next door (隔壁)。

example.en: Taxis and private car pickups are available directly outside terminal arrival gate four.
example.zh: 計程車與自用小客車接送處就設在航廈第四抵達登機門的正外面。

words.mnemonic: 指示方位介系詞：outside the building (在大樓外)。

example.en: Because of component shipment delays, the assembly schedule is currently two days behind schedule.
example.zh: 由於零組件出貨延遲，組裝進度目前落後排程兩天。

words.mnemonic: 專案時程必考片語：behind schedule (落後進度)，反義詞為 ahead of schedule。

example.en: Industry analysts shared their projections regarding global economic growth during the seminar.
example.zh: 產業分析師在研討會中分享了他們對全球經濟成長的預測。

words.mnemonic: 多益常見經濟名詞搭配：economic growth (經濟成長)、economic crisis (經濟危機)。
words.roots: eco 家 + nom 管理 → 家計之學

example.en: The corporate executive committee conducted an on-site inspection of the new manufacturing facility.
example.zh: 企業執行委員會對新製造廠進行了現場實地檢驗。

words.mnemonic: 多益雙重考點：on-site (在現場的)、construction site (施工工地)、web site (網站)。

example.en: The marketing team adopted a customer-centric approach to increase long-term brand loyalty.
example.zh: 行銷團隊採取了一種以客戶為中心的方法，以提升長期的品牌忠誠度。

words.mnemonic: 商業策略常客：innovative approach (創新方法)、approach a problem (著手處理問題)。

example.en: The corporation hired a certified language teacher to conduct business English classes for staff.
example.zh: 該企業聘請了一位專業認證的語言教師為員工開設商務英文課程。

words.mnemonic: 企業在職進修講師：language teacher (語言教師)、training instructor (培訓講師)。

example.en: The commercial charter flight is scheduled to land at Frankfurt International Airport at two.
example.zh: 這架商業包機預定於下午兩點降落在法蘭克福國際機場。

words.mnemonic: 班機降落：the plane landed on time (飛機準時降落)；口語 land a job (贏得好工作)。

example.en: Ms. Liu is the senior executive in charge of international procurement and logistics operations.
example.zh: 劉女士是負責國際採購與物流運營的高階主管。

words.mnemonic: 多益超高頻片語：in charge of (負責主管)、free of charge (免費)。

example.en: After weeks of intense negotiations, both parties finally signed the commercial partnership agreement.
example.zh: 在歷經數週的密集談判後，雙方終於簽署了商業夥伴協議。

words.mnemonic: 轉折與歷程副詞，表示久等後的最終成果。

example.en: Both corporate directors met in the executive boardroom to sign the five-year supply contract.
example.zh: 兩位企業董事在高階主管董事會會議室會面，正式簽署了為期五年的供應合約。

words.mnemonic: 多益商業必背搭配：sign a contract (簽約)、sign in/up (簽到/報名)。

example.en: Passengers whose luggage was delayed may file an official baggage claim at the airline counter.
example.zh: 行李延誤的旅客可在航空公司服務櫃檯提出正式行李索賠。

words.mnemonic: 機場與保險大考點：baggage claim (行李提領處)、file an insurance claim (申請保險理賠)。

example.en: Our sales team is committed to maintaining a strong and transparent relationship with all suppliers.
example.zh: 我們的銷售團隊致力於與所有供應商保持穩固而透明的合作夥伴關係。

words.mnemonic: 公關與商務拓展：business relationship (業務合作關係)。

example.en: Corporate employees who travel on official business are reimbursed according to company policy.
example.zh: 因公出差的企業員工依據公司政策享有費用報銷待遇。

words.mnemonic: 多益出差考點：travel agency (旅行社)、travel expense (差旅費)。

example.en: Registered rewards members enjoy complimentary access to the hotel fitness center and sauna.
example.zh: 註冊會員可免費享用飯店健身休閒中心與三溫暖設施。

words.mnemonic: 會員權益文宣標準動詞：enjoy discounts (享有折扣)。

example.en: The corporate comprehensive life insurance policy provides financial support in the event of death.
example.zh: 企業綜合人壽保險保單在員工不幸身故時提供財務撫恤保障。

words.mnemonic: 員工撫卹與團保名詞：accidental death (意外身故保險)。

example.en: The accounting division keeps an accurate electronic record of all commercial transactions.
example.zh: 會計部門對所有商務交易皆保存有精確無誤的電子紀錄。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 動詞 /rɪˈkɔːrd/ 記錄；名詞 /ˈrɛkərd/ 檔案紀錄：track record (過往績效紀錄)。

example.en: Hotel guests who extend their stay by two days will receive complimentary spa vouchers.
example.zh: 延長住宿兩天的飯店房客將可獲得免費水療抵用券。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 旅館住宿與狀態維持：stay at a hotel (住飯店)、stay informed (保持知悉)。

example.en: The enterprise is expanding its engineering workforce to meet growing demand for cloud services.
example.zh: 該企業正在擴大其工程人力團隊，以滿足對雲端服務日益增長的需求。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益職場最常考複合字：workforce (勞動力/全體員工)、task force (特遣專案小組)。

example.en: The express airport shuttle makes a brief passenger pickup stop outside terminal two.
example.zh: 機場快捷接駁車會在第二航廈外做短暫的旅客上車停靠。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 交通工具停靠：bus stop (公車站)；non-stop (直達的/不間斷的)。

example.en: The hiring committee interviewed several qualified candidates for the senior accounting position.
example.zh: 招募委員會面試了數名具備資歷的應徵者以填補資深會計職缺。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 修飾複數可數名詞：several times (好幾次)、several options (好幾個選項)。

example.en: Please ensure that all overhead office lights are switched off before locking up the building.
example.zh: 在鎖門離開大樓前，請確保所有辦公室頭頂照明皆已關閉。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 商務轉折短語：in light of (有鑑於...)；lightweight (輕量級的)。

example.en: Our software engineers worked diligently to develop a user-friendly mobile banking application.
example.zh: 我們的軟體工程師勤奮工作，以開發出一款操作簡便的手機網銀應用程式。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 研發核心動詞：develop a product (開發產品)、develop a plan (擬定計畫)。

example.en: Please remember to attach your itemized expense receipts when requesting travel reimbursement.
example.zh: 申請差旅費報銷時，請務必記得檢附逐項列記的支出收據。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 叮嚀句型必備：remember to do (記得去做某事)。

example.en: The final contract negotiations took a bit longer than originally anticipated by management.
example.zh: 最終的合約談判比管理層原先預期的時間稍微久了一點。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 副詞修飾片語：a bit (稍微/一點點)、bit by bit (循序漸進)。

example.en: Our new smartphone product line helped the enterprise expand its global market share.
example.zh: 我們的新智慧型手機產品線幫助企業擴大了其全球市場份額。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 商業金融大考點：market share (市占率)、shareholders (股東)。

example.en: The corporate expansion committee consulted an experienced real estate agency to locate new offices.
example.zh: 企業擴張委員會諮詢了一家經驗豐富的房地產經紀公司以尋找新辦公室。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益商業核心考點：real estate (不動產/房地產)。

example.en: Our customer service representatives strive to answer incoming telephone calls within three rings.
example.zh: 我們的客戶服務代表力求在響鈴三聲內接聽進線電話。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 辦公室電話與客服關鍵動詞：answer the phone (接聽電話)。

example.en: Meeting participants are invited to sit around the central conference table.
example.zh: 邀請與會者圍繞中央會議桌就座。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 會議就座用語：sit at a desk (坐在辦公桌前)、be seated (就座)。

example.en: The chief financial officer presented the latest sales figures during the executive briefing.
example.zh: 財務長在主管簡報會議上報告了最新的銷售數據。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 財報最常考名詞：sales figures (銷售數字)、figure out (想出/弄明白)。

example.en: Candidates must submit a cover letter and an updated resume to be considered for the position.
example.zh: 應徵者必須提交求職信與更新的履歷表方能列入該職位的考量。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 求職與推薦必備：cover letter (求職信)、letter of recommendation (推薦信)。

example.en: The board of directors will decide whether to approve the international merger proposal tomorrow.
example.zh: 董事會將於明天決定是否核准該項跨國合併提案。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 決策核心動詞：decide to do (決定做某事)、decide on (決定選擇)。
roots: cide 切 → 切斷猶豫、決定

example.en: Fluency in a second foreign language is a definite advantage for our global marketing applicants.
example.zh: 精通第二外語對於應徵我們全球行銷職缺的求職者而言是一項顯著優勢。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 履歷專長必填欄位：foreign language (外語)、body language (肢體語言)。

example.en: Please write a concise and clear subject line when emailing client project updates.
example.zh: 在透過電子郵件寄送客戶專案進度時，請填寫簡潔明瞭的主旨欄。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 書信主旨與合約條件：subject line (郵件主旨)、subject to change (可能隨時變更)。
roots: ject 丟 → 丟在下面、受支配者

example.en: Corporate business executives traveling on flights over eight hours are eligible for business class.
example.zh: 搭乘飛行時間超過八小時航班的企業高階主管有資格搭乘商務艙。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 機票艙等考點：business class (商務艙)、first class (頭等艙)。

example.en: The enterprise invests heavily in professional employee development and technical training.
example.zh: 該企業大力投資於員工的專業發展與技術培訓。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 科技與人事專有名詞：research and development (研發/R&D)。

example.en: Our newly renovated flagship hotel is centrally situated in the historic section of town.
example.zh: 我們新裝修的旗艦飯店位於該城鎮歷史區的中心地帶。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 市中心核心字：downtown (市中心)、out of town (出城/不在本地)。

example.en: The airport shuttle departs from terminal two every half hour throughout the day.
example.zh: 機場接駁車全天每半小時自第二航廈發車一班。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 時間與財報考點：half an hour (半小時)、first half of the year (上半年)。

example.en: The executive secretary distributed the official meeting minutes to all committee members.
example.zh: 執行秘書向所有委員會成員分發了正式的會議紀錄。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益雙重考點：單數是「分鐘」，複數 meeting minutes 則是「會議紀錄」！

example.en: The corporate catering service provided exquisite food and beverages for the banquet.
example.zh: 企業外燴服務為晚宴提供了精緻的餐飲美食與飲料。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 活動餐飲詞彙：food and beverage (餐飲服務/F&B)、food court (美食街)。

example.en: Workshop attendees will enjoy a fifteen-minute coffee break before the afternoon session begins.
example.zh: 工作坊與會者將在下午會議開始前享受十五分鐘的咖啡茶歇時間。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 會議中場休息：coffee break (茶歇)、take a break (休息一下)。

example.en: The supervisor gave clear and direct instructions on how to file travel reimbursement claims.
example.zh: 主管對於如何申報差旅費報銷提出了清楚而直接的指示。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 清晰度與物流通關：make it clear (說明清楚)、clear customs (通關)。

example.en: We look forward to exploring mutually beneficial business opportunities in the near future.
example.zh: 我們期盼在不久的將來共同探討互利共贏的商業商機。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 書信客套結尾句：in the near future (在不久的將來)。

example.en: Invoices can be settled using either corporate credit cards or direct electronic wire transfers.
example.zh: 發票可以透過企業信用卡或直接電子電匯轉帳任一方式進行結清。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 二選一必考配對句型：either A or B (要麼A要麼B)。

example.en: The new regional warehouse facility became fully operational three months ago.
example.zh: 這座新的區域倉儲設施在三個月前已完全投入營運。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 過去式標誌時間副詞：three days ago (三天前)。

example.en: The parking garage charges four dollars per hour during standard business daytime hours.
example.zh: 該停車場在一般日間營業時段每小時收費四美元。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 計算單位與依據：per hour (每小時)、as per your request (依照您的要求)。

example.en: Despite severe economic market fluctuations, our net operating margins remained strong.
example.zh: 儘管面臨嚴峻的經濟市場波動，我們的營業淨利率依然維持強勁。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 狀態維持動詞：remain competitive (保持競爭力)、remain seated (請保持就坐)。

example.en: Ensuring workplace physical safety remains the top priority of factory plant management.

example.zh: 自動化技術的投資顯著降低了工廠生產製造中的營運勞動人力成本。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 人資與生產核心字彙：labor cost (勞工成本)、skilled labor (熟練勞工)。

example.en: Inspectors verified that the titanium component surface was completely free of scratches.
example.zh: 檢驗人員核實了該鈦金屬零件表面完全沒有任何刮痕瑕疵。

reviewWords.mnemonic: sur- (在...之上) + face (面) ＝ 最上面那一層 ＝ 表面 (surface mail 地面陸運)。

example.en: Employees can access the corporate digital training video library through the internal intranet.
example.zh: 全體員工可透過企業內部網路隨時查閱公司的數位培訓影音資源庫。

reviewWords.mnemonic: libr- (書本) + -ary (場所) ＝ 圖書室，商務上常指數位資料檔案庫 (digital library)。

example.en: The newly recruited marketing specialist demonstrated an excellent command of corporate public relations.
example.zh: 新招募的行銷專員展現了對企業公共關係處理的極其出色的掌控能力。

reviewWords.mnemonic: ex- (出) + cel (超越) + -ent ＝ 出類拔萃的 ＝ 優秀的 (excellent service)。

example.en: Proprietary automated manufacturing processes give our firm a distinct competitive edge.
example.zh: 專利的自動化製造工藝為我們公司帶來了顯著的市場競爭優勢。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益商業核心搭配：competitive edge (競爭優勢)、have an edge over (勝過)。

example.en: New technical recruits attend an intensive two-week software engineering training boot camp.
example.zh: 新進技術人員需參加為期兩週的密集軟體工程培訓訓練營。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 員工職前培訓常見搭配：training camp / boot camp (培訓訓練營)。

example.en: The commercial marketing presentation was tailored specifically to appeal to our target corporate audience.
example.zh: 這場商務行銷簡報經過專門量身規劃，以精準吸引我們的企業目標受眾族群。

reviewWords.mnemonic: audi- (聽) + -ence (名詞) ＝ 聆聽的受眾群 ＝ 聽眾、目標受眾 (target audience)。

example.en: The regulatory commerce committee officially voted to lift export trade restrictions on semiconductors.
example.zh: 商務監管委員會正式投票通過解除對半導體產品的出口貿易限制。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益雙考點：lift restrictions (解除限制禁令) 或英式電梯 (take the lift)。

example.en: Please send a confirmation email with the signed non-disclosure agreement attached.
example.zh: 請發送一封隨附已簽署保密合約的確認電子郵件。

reviewWords.mnemonic: e (electronic) + mail ＝ 電子郵件 (confirmation email)。

example.en: Our international enterprise logistics network serves global corporate clients across five continents.
example.zh: 我們的跨國企業物流網路為橫跨五大洲的全球企業客戶提供優質服務。

reviewWords.mnemonic: globe (地球) + -al (形容詞尾) ＝ 全球性的 (global economy / market)。

example.en: Small retail shops often struggle to compete against large multinational discount e-commerce chains.
example.zh: 小型零售門市在與大型跨國平價電子商務連鎖集團競爭時往往苦苦苦苦支撐。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 商業困境常用：struggle to compete (艱困競爭)、struggle to survive (掙扎求存)。

example.en: The corporate human resources department will advertise the vacant engineering position online.
example.zh: 企業人力資源部將在網路上刊登招聘該出缺工程師職位的公開徵才廣告。

reviewWords.mnemonic: ad- (向) + vert (轉向) ＝ 把大眾注意力轉移過來 ＝ 登廣告 (advertise a position)。

example.en: There is little doubt that the proposed budget reductions will impact marketing activities.
example.zh: 毫無疑問，擬定之預算縮減將會對行銷推廣活動產生影響。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益閱讀常見修飾不可數名詞表否定 (little doubt 毫無疑問)；a little 表少量。

example.en: Our technical support hotline is open twenty-four hours a day to help registered users.
example.zh: 我們的技術支援專線全天候二十四小時開放，隨時為註冊用戶提供協助。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 客服宗旨用語：help someone with something (協助某人某事)；help desk (諮詢台)。

example.en: Attendees are warmly encouraged to ask questions at the conclusion of the workshop.
example.zh: 熱烈歡迎與會人員在工作坊結束時踴躍提問。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 問答環節必備動詞：ask questions (提問)；ask for approval (請求核准)。

example.en: Our latest batch of electronic components meets all strict industrial quality standards.
example.zh: 我們最新一批電子零組件符合所有嚴格的工業品質標準。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益最經典考點！meet 除了見面，更常考「符合/滿足」：meet standards, meet deadlines。

example.en: The orientation program for newly recruited employees will start promptly at nine o'clock.
example.zh: 新進員工到職培訓計畫將於上午九點整準時開始。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 會議、專案或機具啟動的核心動詞：start a project (啟動專案)。

example.en: The human resources manager arranged a session to talk about employee benefits and healthcare.
example.zh: 人力資源經理安排了一場說明會，以討論員工福利與健保制度。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 商談必備動詞：talk about (討論某事)、talk with (與某人交談)。

example.en: If you notice something wrong with your online billing statement, notify customer service at once.
example.zh: 若您發現線上對帳單有任何異常之處，請立即通知客戶服務部。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 客戶問題反饋常用句型：something wrong (有異常/出問題)。

example.en: Management decided to put together a special committee to oversee the office relocation.
example.zh: 管理層決定籌組一個專責委員會來督導辦公室搬遷事宜。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 商務片語高頻考點：put together (組建/彙整)、put off (延期)。

example.en: The office administrator ordered ten boxes of recycled printer paper for the copy room.
example.zh: 辦公室管理員為影印室訂購了十箱環保再生印表機紙張。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 辦公用紙與無紙化辦公：paperless office (無紙化辦公室)、paper trail (書面追蹤紀錄)。

example.en: Over fifty qualified applicants submitted resumes for the managerial position in accounting.
example.zh: 五十多名具備資歷的求職者為會計部主管職位投遞了履歷。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 求職招募核心字：apply for a position (應徵職位)、fill a position (補齊職缺)。

example.en: The flagship corporate hotel is located near the city center and convenient transportation links.
example.zh: 這間企業旗艦飯店坐落於市中心與便利的交通轉運節點附近。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 飯店與辦公室選址片語：near the airport (靠近機場)、in the near future (在不久的將來)。

example.en: Candidates should forward their updated credentials directly to the human resources department.
example.zh: 應徵者應將其更新的資歷直接發送至人力資源部。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益最高頻部門名稱：Human Resources (HR 人資部)。

example.en: The information technology division installed new security antivirus software on every office computer.
example.zh: 資訊科技部門在每台辦公室電腦上安裝了全新的防毒安全軟體。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 辦公科技詞彙：computer software (電腦軟體)、computer system (電腦系統)。

example.en: Customer service management took prompt action to resolve the difficult billing dispute situation.
example.zh: 客戶服務主管採取了迅速行動，以妥善化解棘手的帳單爭議處境。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 應對狀況詞彙：win-win situation (雙贏局面)、handle a situation (處理狀況)。

example.en: All administrative staff members are required to attend the mandatory corporate compliance seminar.
example.zh: 所有行政員工皆必須參加強制性企業法規遵從研討會。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益最核心集合名詞：staff meeting (員工會議)、staff member (職員)。

example.en: The corporate human resources department organized a series of team-building activities this weekend.
example.zh: 企業人力資源部在本週末籌辦了一系列團隊凝聚活動。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 促銷與團隊凝聚用語：promotional activity (宣傳活動)、team-building activity (團隊凝聚活動)。

example.en: The creative advertising agency produced a promotional documentary film to introduce the brand.
example.zh: 這家創意廣告公司製作了一部宣傳紀錄短片以向大眾介紹該品牌。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 影音宣傳常見詞：training film (培訓影片)、promotional film (宣傳短片)。

example.en: The annual corporate executive strategy briefing will begin at nine in the morning.
example.zh: 年度企業高階主管策略簡報將於上午九點開始。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 會議時程高頻詞：morning meeting (早會)、in the morning (在上午)。

example.en: A fierce price war between competing budget airlines reduced regional ticket fares considerably.
example.zh: 廉價航空公司之間激烈的價格戰大幅降低了區域機票票價。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益商業比喻經典詞彙：price war (價格戰)。

example.en: Clients can log into their online corporate banking account to review pending invoices.
example.zh: 客戶可以登入其線上企業網銀帳戶以審查待處理發票。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益雙重必考點：bank account (銀行帳戶)、account for (占...比例/說明原因)。

example.en: Consumers can shop for discounted office furniture online or visit our downtown showroom.
example.zh: 消費者可以在線上選購打折辦公家具，亦可親臨我們的市中心展示門市。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 購物與展示中心：gift shop (禮品店)、online shopping (線上購物)。

example.en: Securing the government infrastructure contract was a major achievement for our construction firm.
example.zh: 拿下政府公共工程合約是我們營造公司的一項重大成就。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 重大突破常用詞：major client (主要客戶)、major factor (主要因素)。

example.en: If you require emergency technical assistance after business hours, someone will answer your call.
example.zh: 若您在下班時間後需要緊急技術協助，將會有專人接聽您的電話。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 客服待命服務描寫詞：someone will assist you (會有專人協助您)。

example.en: All employees should comply with the health and safety regulations stated in the manual above.
example.zh: 所有員工皆應遵守上述手冊中所陳述的健康與安全規章。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 文件引用最常考短語：as mentioned above (如上所述)、all of the above (以上皆是)。

example.en: Our creative team finalized the modern visual design for the corporate annual report.
example.zh: 我們的創意團隊為企業年度報告定稿了現代化的視覺設計。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 研發與行銷高頻詞：graphic design (平面設計)、design team (設計團隊)。
roots: sign 記號 → 畫下記號

example.en: The international trade gala is expected to be the premier networking event of the year.
example.zh: 國際商貿晚會預計將成為今年最首屈一指的商務交流盛會。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 公關活動與突發狀況：in the event of (萬一發生/在...情況下)。

example.en: Subscribers who renew their annual software licenses today receive a special promotional discount.
example.zh: 今日續訂年度軟體授權的訂閱用戶可獲享一項專案促銷折扣。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 廣告文宣高頻搭配：special offer (特別優惠)、special occasion (特殊場合)。

example.en: Severe crosswinds sometimes cause temporary passenger boarding delays at the coastal airport.
example.zh: 強烈的側風有時會導致該沿海機場暫時發生旅客登機延誤。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 頻率副詞常客，描寫偶發性維修或延遲。

example.en: Customers must review the warranty terms and conditions carefully before completing the transaction.
example.zh: 顧客在完成交易前必須仔細審閱保固條款與各項條件。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益合約與二手品必備：terms and conditions (條款與條件)、in good condition (狀況良好)。

example.en: Our downtown department store does not currently carry that particular brand of laptop.
example.zh: 我們的市中心百貨公司門市目前並未販售那一款特定品牌的筆記型電腦。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益聽力 Part 3/4 超愛考：carry 除了攜帶，商場情境常指「販售/備有商品」！

example.en: Online shoppers can choose from three secure payment options at the checkout portal.
example.zh: 線上購物顧客可以在結帳入口網站中從三種安全的付款選項中進行選擇。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 選購動詞：choose between A and B (在A與B之間做選擇)。

example.en: The corporate parental leave policy grants paid leave to any new father following childbirth.
example.zh: 該企業的育嬰假政策為孩子出生後的每位新手父親提供帶薪陪產假。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 員工育兒與福利政策：paternity leave (陪產假)。

example.en: The corporate executive board reached a unanimous decision to expand into Latin American markets.
example.zh: 企業執行董事會一致做出擴張進軍拉丁美洲市場的決定。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益商業決策超核心片語：make a decision (做決策)、reach a decision (達成決定)。

example.en: Please reserve a private dining table for six clients at the hotel restaurant tonight.
example.zh: 今晚請在飯店餐廳為六位客戶預訂一張獨立私人用餐餐桌。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 餐廳訂位與會議圖表：reserve a table (預約餐桌)、table of contents (目錄)。

example.en: Promotional discounts are applicable only to certain designated electronic merchandise items.
example.zh: 促銷折扣僅適用於某些指定的電子商品項目。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 限制條款常見用法：under certain conditions (在特定條件下)。

example.en: We sincerely look forward to establishing a productive business partnership with your firm.
example.zh: 我們由衷期盼能與貴公司建立富有成效的商業合作夥伴關係。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益信件最經典結尾句型：look forward to + V-ing (期盼...)；forward an email (轉寄郵件)。

example.en: The main entrance to the corporate headquarters is equipped with electronic badge scanners.
example.zh: 企業總部大樓的主入口處配備有電子感應掃描機。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 設施與要點必備形容詞：main entrance (大門/主入口)、main office (總辦公室)。

example.en: If the laptop battery happens to die during the presentation, connect the emergency AC power cord.
example.zh: 簡報時筆記型電腦電池若碰巧沒電耗盡，請立即接上緊急交流電源線。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 電子設備電力耗盡商務情境：battery died (電池沒電了)。

example.en: According to the export contract, the vendor will bear all shipping and customs insurance costs.
example.zh: 依據出口合約約定，賣方將承擔所有的運費與海關保險費用。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益合約高頻商務搭配：bear the cost (負擔費用)、bear responsibility (承擔責任)。

example.en: Management decided to cut operating expenses by fifteen percent this fiscal quarter.
example.zh: 管理層決定在這一會計季度中將營運費用削減百分之十五。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益財報常見搭配：cut costs (削減成本)、budget cut (預算刪減)。

example.en: The brochure clearly describes the unique features and specifications of our new software.
example.zh: 這份宣傳手冊清楚地描述了我們新軟體的獨特功能與規格。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 字根 scrib/script 表「寫/描述」，如 description (說明)。
roots: scrib 寫 → 寫下來、描述

example.en: The chief executive officer himself attended the ribbon-cutting ceremony for the new facility.
example.zh: 執行長本人親自出席了新廠房的剪綵典禮。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 強調主詞親自出席或執行：by himself (獨自/親自)。

example.en: Our new mobile application is especially popular among younger business professionals.
example.zh: 我們的新行動應用程式在年輕商務專業人士之間特別受歡迎。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 加強焦點副詞，突出特定受眾或特定情境。

example.en: The company reported strong financial growth across all international retail divisions.
example.zh: 該公司各國際零售部門均呈現出強勁的財務增長。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 財報與人才能力常用：strong growth (強勁成長)、strong candidate (優秀人選)。

example.en: Online sales revenue is expected to rise sharply during the upcoming holiday shopping season.
example.zh: 預計線上銷售額將在即將到來的假日購物季中大幅上升。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益不規則動詞 (rise, rose, risen)，為不及物動詞，主詞自發上升。

example.en: The corporate foundation sponsored educational science workshops for young girls in local schools.
example.zh: 企業基金會為當地學校的年輕女童資助了教育科學工作坊。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 企業社會責任 (CSR) 與公益贊助活動常考字彙。

example.en: Maybe we should schedule a follow-up consultation before finalizing the vendor contract.
example.zh: 也許我們應該在敲定供應商合約之前安排一次後續諮詢會議。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 聽力 Part 3/4 會議討論中提出委婉建議時常用句首詞。

example.en: The enterprise actively supports the local community through volunteer mentorship initiatives.
example.zh: 該企業透過志工導師培訓倡議，積極支持在地社區發展。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 企業永續與社區公關：community outreach (社區關懷推廣)。
